subject: Proposal: organic realignment and reporting impact plan
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Raman <asha@orgconsult.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: organic realignment and reporting impact plan

Team —

Attached is an initial proposal for a modest realignment across Serving Runtime, Edge Runtime, and Performance Engineering. High level summary:

- Move Edge Runtime (currently under Product Infra) to report into Serving Runtime for a single end-to-end inference org. Rationale: reduce cross-team coordination for low-latency initiatives and unify kernel/ops roadmaps.
- Fold Performance Engineering (4 ICs + lead) into Infrastructure Reliability to centralize QoS ownership and make batching/latency improvements more consistent.
- Reduce manager span in Serving Runtime by shifting one manager role into a platform-focused lead (creates one consolidated IC ladder adjustment).

Why now: recurring cross-team blockers on latency work, and overlapping reviewer cycles that are creating heavy cognitive load for a handful of managers. This is intended to be organic (no immediate layoffs); instead we want role scope changes, clear reporting lines, and an orderly performance-review calibration.

HR / timeline implications:
- We need People Ops to help with the calibration during the upcoming performance reviews. Monica, can you confirm timing windows and if the comp team needs a different notice period?
- Legal/Finance will want to see comp-impact modeling; attached is a first-pass spreadsheet.

Request: please review the attached org-chart (v0), comp-impact model, and the comm scripts draft. I’d like feedback by end of day Mon, Aug 3 so we can sync with People Ops and Asha (consultant) for a comms runbook on Aug 4.

Attachments: 20260801-org-chart-proposal.pdf, comp-impact-model.xlsx, comm-scripts-draft.md

Thanks —
Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Asha Raman <asha@orgconsult.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: organic realignment and reporting impact plan

Laura —

Thanks for the clear write-up. A few quick items from my side:

1) Headcount & comp impact: the spreadsheet looks clean but I need a cell-level breakdown of ongoing budget delta vs one-time transition costs. Will Finance need approvals for any promoted manager comp bumps?
2) Performance review risk: moving people between review lines right before calibration can cause perception issues. Monica — can we run a small calibration subgroup (Directors + People Ops) rather than the full calibration panel?
3) Manager spans: shifting a manager into platform-focused work is fine if we confirm there is no single point-of-failure on oncall. Suggest a 6-week overlapping handoff window to avoid gaps.

Minor: please call out any roles that will change levels (IC->Senior IC, Mgr->Sr Mgr) in the next version; that will help People Ops update the career ladder docs.

-Vivek
VP, Platform Engineering

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Asha Raman <asha@orgconsult.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: organic realignment and reporting impact plan

Laura / Vivek —

Happy to help. A few operational notes from People Ops:

- Calibration timing: Our quarterly calibration meeting is Aug 10; to make any formal rating changes we need manager inputs by Aug 5 for the calibration packet. If we keep the structural change as a reporting-line move without re-rating, we can communicate a role-scope change now and defer rating changes to the next cycle, but that must be communicated clearly to managers and impacted ICs.
- Comp approvals: Promotions or title changes that trigger band midpoint increases require sign-off from Comp and Finance. Please flag any proposed promotions in the next draft.
- Sensitive comms: Recommend the following cadence for impacted individuals: (1) manager 1:1s within 48 hours of announcement, (2) optional skip-level notes from your office for any role with >10% scope change, (3) offer optional 30-day review follow-up meeting. The attached comm-scripts-draft.md contains manager language for these cases.

On calibration subgroup: yes, a smaller panel (Laura, Vivek, Monica, Markus, comp rep) is reasonable for the first pass. Asha can help us run a mock script to test manager Q&A.

I’ll also need a list of impacted people and current reviewer assignments to create the calibration packet. If you put that in the sheet we can turn it into an HR action list.

—Monica
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Asha Raman <asha@orgconsult.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: organic realignment and reporting impact plan

+1 on a staged approach. A couple product-side considerations:

- Feature-level ownership: If Edge Runtime moves into Serving Runtime, product managers and roadmap owners need to be re-pointed so KPIs (latency P95, error rate, rollout velocity) are still observable per-product. Please include a short mapping of PM owners in v1 of the chart.
- APAC pilot: Given our recent traffic growth in APAC and the slightly different infra topology there, I recommend piloting the new reporting model with the APAC edge team for 8 weeks before global rollout. It will give us operational signals without disturbing the larger US teams.

Also, small ask: can we include a short FAQ for customer-facing teams? Sales and CS will ask the usual questions; a one-pager that says "no change to SLAs, no data access changes" would be helpful.

Thanks —
Steph
VP, Product (Inference)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Raman <asha@orgconsult.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: organic realignment and reporting impact plan

Thanks all — good feedback and aligned on approach. Quick summary of next steps (owners & dates):

- Laura: update org-chart with PM mapping and explicit level-changes called out (v1 -> ready EOD Mon Aug 3). Attachment: updated chart will be 20260803-org-chart-v1.pdf.
- Monica: prepare calibration packet and confirm comp sign-off process (due Wed Aug 5).
- Vivek: confirm handoff windows and oncall overlap plan; propose 6-week cadence and list owners (due Tue Aug 4).
- Steph: pilot plan for APAC edge handoff; draft pilot success metrics (due Tue Aug 4).
- Asha: comms runbook and mock manager script; runbook session scheduled Aug 4 10:00-11:30 PT.

Meeting: I’ll schedule a 45-minute sync for Mon Aug 3 at 10:00 PT to review v1 and finalize the communication timeline. Please come prepared with suggested FAQ bullets for Sales/CS.

Note re: sensitive communication: Monica — agree that managers should do 1:1s before public announcement. We will not change compensation immediately during announcement; any promotions that change comp will be handled as separate HR actions with capex approval where needed.

If no objections by EOD Mon Aug 3 I’ll mark this plan as green and we’ll proceed with the pilot + calibration schedule.

Thanks again — appreciate everyone moving quickly on this.

Laura
Director, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
